A Proactive Defense Against Vandalism and Damage

Vandalism is an unfortunate and costly reality for many commercial property owners in urban areas. Replacing a large pane of glass that has been scratched, etched with acid, or spray-painted can cost thousands of dollars. Anti-graffiti film offers a simple, effective, and affordable alternative. This optically clear, sacrificial film is applied to the exterior of your glass or other smooth surfaces, taking the brunt of any damage.

How Anti-Graffiti Film Works

Think of it as a screen protector for your building. If a vandal strikes, they damage the film, not the expensive surface underneath. Our technicians can then quickly and easily remove the damaged film and apply a new layer, restoring your property's appearance for a fraction of the cost of replacement.

The benefits are clear:

  • Cost Savings: Dramatically reduces the cost associated with repairing or replacing vandalized property.
  • Fast Recovery: Film replacement is much faster than ordering and installing new glass, minimizing downtime and maintaining your business's professional appearance.
  • Invisible Protection: The film is virtually undetectable, so it doesn't alter the look of your property.
  • Versatile Application: Protects not just glass but also other non-porous surfaces like stainless steel, mirrors, and marble that are common targets for vandals.
  • UV Blocking: As an added benefit, our anti-graffiti films also block over 99% of harmful UV rays, helping to reduce fading of merchandise displayed near windows.

Ideal for High-Traffic Public Spaces

Anti-graffiti film is a must-have for properties in high-traffic urban areas, including:

  • Retail Storefronts: Protect your valuable display windows from scratches and tags.
  • Public Transportation: Used extensively on bus shelters, train windows, and in subway stations.
  • Building Directories & Elevators: Safeguard mirrors and metal surfaces inside and out.
  • Schools and Public Buildings: Reduce maintenance budgets by protecting against common forms of vandalism.

Don't wait for vandals to strike. Protect your investment with a proactive solution. Contact Arizona House of Film to learn more about our anti-graffiti services.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is anti-graffiti film thick enough to stop deep scratches?

Yes, our standard anti-graffiti films are typically 4 to 6 mil thick and are designed to protect against 'keying,' scratching, and even acid etching. The film absorbs the damage, leaving the glass underneath pristine.

Can you see the edges of the film once it's installed?

Our professional installers are highly skilled at trimming the film for a precise, clean fit. Once installed, the film is virtually invisible to the naked eye.

How quickly can a damaged film be replaced?

Film replacement is a very fast process. Our technicians can typically remove the old film and install the new one in a single service visit, restoring your property's appearance almost immediately.
